verdict.rationale: Mercury's documented REST API covers the core accounting data a developer needs to view and manage. It can list and get transactions, update transaction metadata, upload attachments, create, edit and delete categories, download statement PDFs and list merchants. A separate Accounts Receivable API manages customers and invoices, and the API can be tested in a sandbox with scoped tokens. Missing for 10: endpoints for general-ledger or chart-of-accounts mapping (the QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite sync is not shown as API-accessible), a publicly downloadable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of the accounting endpoints.
